name: Delaunay Flux
desc: A living low-poly web whose Delaunay triangulation is rebuilt every frame from a cloud of drifting points, so triangles flex, edges flip and cells breathe while centroid-position hue paints the mesh from an iq cosine palette under bright glowing edges.

density.doc: point count / mesh fineness (40..120 drifting points)

hue.doc: palette base hue (spatial rainbow rotates around it)

x.doc: gem light direction x / sparkle anchor

y.doc: gem light direction y / sparkle anchor
